subject: Post-call: Context length & token volumes — pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@acme.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 20:20:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: Context length & token volumes — pricing follow-up

Hi Oliver / Samira —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can put together a tailored pricing + pilot plan: 

What I heard today (please correct if I mis-summarize):
- Primary use: AI-assisted drafting + long-context retrieval for enterprise docs (search -> generate summaries / Q&A).
- Expected monthly inference: ~40–60M tokens to start; growth to 200M+ over 12 months if results are strong.
- Typical session: prompt + retrieval context + generation; rough ballpark you mentioned about ~500 prompt tokens and O(1k) completion tokens on average but with occasional very long summaries.
- Context needs: most queries fit within 8k but some legal/contract summaries will require 32k; a small subset (archival or long thread synthesis) may benefit from 128k occasionally.

Couple of asks so we can price correctly: 
1) Can you confirm average prompt tokens and average completion tokens (means / 95th perc.)?
2) Rough % of sessions that need >8k, >32k, and >128k context (ballpark is fine).
3) Any internal target $/1M tokens you had in mind (budget range)?
4) Do you expect a heavy read-to-generate ratio (i.e., lots of retrieval tokens added to prompt) — if so, please share average retrieval size per request.

Attached: token_breakdown.xlsx — a template you can paste a small sample into if easier than replying inline.

Next steps from our side once we get your numbers:
- Provide a blended pricing estimate for 8k / 32k / 128k context profiles.
- Recommend batching/caching and quantization profiles for your workload.
- Propose a short profiling pilot (2 weeks) to capture real token distributions and tune unit economics.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Rishi & Laura to help size a pilot and model selection.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[redwood-pricing.pdf attached]

From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context length & token volumes — pricing follow-up

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Confirming numbers from our end (based on a 2-week internal trace):
- Avg prompt tokens (mean): ~480 tokens; 95th pct ~1,600 tokens (includes retrieved snippets).
- Avg completion tokens (mean): ~1,200 tokens; 95th pct ~6,800 tokens for the long summarization flows.
- Monthly token expectation: 45M initial; runway to ~150–200M within 9–12 months if we roll out broadly.
- Context needs: roughly 78% of requests fit inside 8k, ~18% need up to 32k, and ~4% spike into the 128k range for legal/archival synthesis.
- Retrieval size per request (median): ~2,500 tokens (we bring back a few long docs).

Budget-wise, the finance/ops team is looking for something in the ~$30–$45 per 1M tokens range (blended) — ideally closer to $40/1M. We understand large-context pricing will be higher; would like to see options.

Question: do you price prompt vs completion separately or provide a blended per-token rate? Also curious how caching/batching could reduce our effective spend on the retrieval-heavy flows.

Oliver
Oliver Hayes
Head of AI Platform, ACME Corp
oliver.hayes@acme.ai | +1 (212) 555-0110

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@acme.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context length & token volumes — pricing follow-up

Thanks Oliver — this is super helpful. Below is an initial pricing + unit economics note and a proposed pilot to validate distribution and optimize costs.

High-level pricing (example blended units; final quote will depend on model family / quality tier):
- 8k context (baseline): $30 per 1M tokens (blended prompt+completion).
- 32k context: $45 per 1M tokens (blended).
- 128k context: $90 per 1M tokens (blended).

Notes on the numbers:
- These are blended rates (we bill prompt+completion tokens together). If you prefer split billing (prompt vs completion) we can provide that, but in practice most customers find blended easier for forecasting.
- Caching & batching: with prefix caching and retrieval deduplication we often see 10–25% effective token reduction on retrieval-heavy workloads. For your median 2,500-token retrievals that could materially reduce spend.
- Model selection: we recommend using our 8k-optimized model for the majority of traffic and routing the 18% of requests that require larger windows to a 32k-optimized variant. Only the 4% 128k spikes would route to the largest context model; we can configure automatic fallback to keep SLAs tight.

Example monthly spend (rough):
- If you run 45M tokens and distribution is 78% @8k, 18% @32k, 4% @128k, blended spend estimate: ~ $1,700–$2,100 / month (this is illustrative — actual depends on exact prompt/completion split and model).

Pilot proposal (next step):
1) 2-week profiling run where we ingest ~5–10k representative requests and capture true token distributions and latency. I’ll share profiling-instructions.md (attached).
2) We offer a pilot discount: 15% off the blended pilot rate and a $10k credit to cover initial volume — aim is to reduce friction for engineering to test at scale.
3) After profiling we’ll return a detailed quote with recommended batching/caching knobs and a projected $/1M tokens with and without optimizations.

If that works, can we schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff next week to outline the sample dataset (anonymized) and set an ingestion window? I can do Mon/Tue morning PST.

Thanks — attaching redwood-pricing.pdf and profiling-instructions.md for your review.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Quick internal — looping you both for pricing/approval:
- ACME confirmed 45M initial tokens; distribution ~= 78% 8k / 18% 32k / 4% 128k.
- Finance target: ~$30–$45 / 1M blended (they’re aiming toward $40).
- I proposed pilot: 2 weeks profiling, 15% pilot discount + $10k credit.

Can we approve the pilot credit and the preliminary blended rates (30/45/90)? If you want a different pilot structure (e.g., timeboxed rather than credit-based) say the word.

Thanks — I’ll hold tentative kickoff slots Mon 9:00–11:00 & Tue 9:00–11:00 PST.

— Marissa
